item.title: Provider onboarding documents
item.body: Provider onboarding asks for documents such as proof of malpractice insurance, a completed W-9 tax form and current license information. The provider portal shows which documents are received and which are still missing. Credentialing decisions are made by the credentialing team, not by the assistant.
